A hopper on legs with an iron spinner under it. It holds 9 stacks of fertilizer: Compost, Wood Ash, Basic Slag or Mixed Fertilizer. Use it with fertilizer to fill it (hoppers and conduits work too); sneak-use with an empty hand to empty it.
Every 2 seconds it checks the Loam Farmland in the 5x5 around it, down to 3 blocks below, and spreads one fertilizer on any whose nutrients have dropped below 4. It needs no power or redstone.
